verdict.rationale: Jitsu documents a public Management API with a full OpenAPI 3.0 reference at docs.jitsu.com/api, covering workspaces, destinations, connections, syncs and functions. Nothing in the evidence shows that reference is interactive or has runnable examples. A probe found no machine-readable OpenAPI spec at the common candidate paths, though it did not test the documented /api path. Missing for 10: evidence of an interactive try-it console, runnable request examples, a reachable OpenAPI spec file, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: A public Management API for every Jitsu instance, with a full OpenAPI 3.0 reference at docs.jitsu.com/api.
Jitsu exposes an HTTP API for managing workspaces, sites, destinations, connections, syncs and functions.
